name: Troll, Two-Headed (3pp) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Troll, Two-Headed (3pp) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Troll, Two-Headed" but are not part of the Troll, Two-Headed (3pp) entry, which is unchanged.

hp 103 (9d8+63); regeneration 5 (acid or fire)
Fort +10, Ref +3, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +13 (1d6+8), 2 bites +13 (1d8+8)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks rend (2 claws, 1d6+8)

TACTICS

The beast tries to frighten and demoralize opponents on the first round of combat using Intimidate. He then moves to engage the largest looking foe in melee. Dim to the point of foolishness, he fights to the death, roaring defiance with both heads.
